No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. The educational corrosion mark retains two tilted closed tubes with mouth rims, four separated drops in two columns, a notched material target and an open hand with one thumb and four individually outlined fingers. The frame is vertically extended to the allowed page height; tubes, drops, hand and target positions are independently re-laid out. Finger widths are 8.8 mm, with 4.4 mm between centreline boundaries. No drop is drawn in contact with a target.
